source_summary: Horizontal ink-and-light-color Chinese landscape with misty pale mountains, rocky terraces, leafless trees, pine groves, a pavilion cluster, bridges, and layered cliffs. Calligraphy, seal, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motif extraction.

motifs.name: misty_left_peak_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant mountain range on the left half: several soft triangular peaks rising through gray-green mist behind the foreground rocks, including the tall central-left peak and smaller adjacent peaks, but excluding the inscription and seal above.
must_preserve: faint gray ink outlines along peak ridges
soft pale interior washes with nearly unpainted summit faces
misty gray-green atmospheric wash around the bases
subtle overlapping silhouettes of the smaller rear peaks

motifs.name: left_rocky_bank_with_shrubs
motifs.description: Isolate the left foreground rocky embankment with layered stone ledges, rounded boulders, and small dark shrubs perched on the bank beneath the distant peaks.
must_preserve: horizontal ledge linework across the bank
dry-brush rock texture and mottled gray wash
small clustered shrub strokes on the upper ledge
rounded boulder contours at the lower edge
soft transition into surrounding mist

motifs.name: central_leafless_trees_boulders
motifs.description: Isolate the central foreground group of bare trees growing among rounded rocks: dark forked trunks, fine branch networks, and clustered boulders at their base.
must_preserve: dark ink trunks with tapering forked branches
fine twig linework spreading left and right
rounded boulder outlines and dry-brush shading
gray wash texture in the rock masses
contrast between black tree silhouettes and pale stones

motifs.name: middle_cliff_bamboo_terrace
motifs.description: Isolate the middle elevated rocky terrace near the center-right, with flat cliff-top ledges, layered rock faces, sparse bamboo and leafless tree stems along the rim.
must_preserve: flat horizontal terrace contour
broken dry-brush cliff-face strokes
thin vertical bamboo stems and twig clusters
dark ink accents along the ledge edge
pale wash on the terrace top and mottled rock shadows

motifs.name: upper_right_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the large upper-right mountain massif: overlapping steep pale peaks with dark textured ridgelines and vertical creases, excluding the lower pavilion and pine grove.
must_preserve: dark dotted ridge texture near the summits
long vertical dry-brush striations down the slopes
overlapping peak geometry
pale unpainted mountain faces
soft gray wash around the mountain edges

motifs.name: pine_sheltered_pavilion_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion and house cluster nestled among tall pines in the lower right middle ground, including the multi-tier sloping roofs and surrounding straight pine trunks.
must_preserve: angular sloping roof geometry
thin architectural linework for walls and eaves
tall vertical pine trunks around the buildings
short stacked pine-needle strokes with blue-green accents
pale ground ledge beneath the structures

motifs.name: stone_bridge_over_gorge
motifs.description: Isolate the small arched stone bridge and narrow gorge below the middle-right terrace, including the curved bridge line, path-like ledge, and rock walls around it.
must_preserve: delicate arched bridge contour
thin path lines leading toward the bridge
vertical rock wall strokes beneath the ledge
dry-brush shading in the gorge
small dark ink accents defining the bridge opening

motifs.name: right_foreground_willow_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right foreground riverbank-like mass with drooping willow branches, tangled dark brush, rounded rocks, and the pale sloping bank beneath.
must_preserve: arching willow limbs with many drooping branchlets
dense dark tangled brush strokes
rounded boulders with gray wash shading
pale bank contour sweeping across the bottom
blue-green wash accents on the nearby evergreen strokes

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
